name: A Croaking Cryptid
lore: For untold years, superstitions have persisted in the northwestern Auburn Forest that a giant frog monster haunts the quiet bog. Though many believe the tales to be no more than attention-seeking fibbery, there is an unexpected truth behind this legend...

steps.text: At -2206, 11, -1435 is a door with a handle shaped like a frog. Interact with it and select "...Hi?", then "You seem disappointed...".
Go east to the small house in the Frog Bog and speak with Fia at -2092, 20, -1408. Select "Know of any "good green liquid"?", then "Alright, what is your deal?" to get a Muddy Shovel.
Hold the shovel outside the brewery and sparkling spots appear. Stand right on top of the one at -2096, 14, -1411 and right-click to dig up the Prized Bottle Cap.
Talk to Fia again and select "I found the heirloom." to get an Auburn Absinthe.
Go back to the frog door, interact with it and select "[Offer Auburn Absinthe]". The door opens and the discovery is found.

name: A Deathly Warning
lore: Atop of the Tower of Ascension stands a being who claims to be Death himself. While such claims are a lie, it can't be ignored that the imposter has horrendous amounts of power, from an unknown source.

steps.text: Go under the ice at the south end of the river, at the end of the river there is a block of cracked ice. Left-click it to enter the cave.

name: A Dividing Force
lore: The river dividing the two forests has acted as a barrier against the Decay for decades. Using her powers, Lari has single handedly kept the Decay from spreading further south.

steps.text: Walk in the cave
Walk deeper into the cave until the cutscene with Lari starts

name: A Hero's Origin
lore: In the year 854 AP (After Portal), a massive horde of undead led by Bak'al attacked Ragni. The people of the city sought refuge in the sewer, the only safe place left.

steps.text: Phantom Soldiers hint at this discovery. Interact with the Emerald Block at -872, 49, -1978 to open a room with Phantom Soldiers inside.
A Phantom Soldier labelled ??? walks out of the room and leads you to the sewers, which open.

name: A House Divided
lore: House Nasin once held nearly unparalleled prestige. Gale's departure, around 200 years ago however, was a blow that House Nasin is just now beginning to recover from.

steps.text: Speak to the House Nasin Butler at -997, 130, -1187 to get the keyring. The library is behind the large chair in the main room.
Sort the library's books: Book Three on Shelf One, Book One on Shelf Two, Book Five on Shelf Three, Book Four on Shelf Four and Book Two on Shelf Five.
Follow the central staircase into the mansion's underground cemetery. Interact with the left coffin at -887, 119, -1192 to obtain the third key.
Head back up the side stairs to open the middle room and steal the fourth key from the Sleeping Scribe at -921, 147, -1185.
Use this key to open the room on the left hallway at -951, 146, -1172 to unlock the discovery.

name: A Monument of Hope
lore: Just as the darkness infiltrated Gavel, the Light was able to protect the physical bodies of the miners in Lutho by erecting this Monolith.

steps.text: Climb up the ladders on the sides of the bank and follow the brown carpets until you reach the base of the Monolith.
Then follow the instructions in red: pick up a shard and complete the parkour.
At the top of the Monolith, place the shard and jump into the hole that opens. Trigger all three parkour paths first, or you are teleported down with "The Monolith rules you unworthy."

name: A People's Sovereign
lore: Once, the people of Hyloch had a Sovereign who cared to hear their thoughts and opinions. When Majin took the mantle, that changed.

steps.text: Located on the West side of Hyloch at -1403, 118, -1278 is the town's dye market. If any of the items needed for this discovery are lost, they can be obtained again by speaking with the NPC it was received from.
Speak to Girazh at the entrance to purchase the Purple Dye Residue from him.
Choose "Yes".

Next, follow the three ladders to the South of the market to reach the highest floor. Speak to Bassow on the stone balcony overlooking Lake Gitephe at -1421, 134, -1268 to obtain the next dye ingredient.
Go down one floor to speak to Nawild at -1420, 125, -1261 and give her both dye ingredients to obtain the Peacock Feather.
Go back down to the first floor and speak with Robboss at -1400, 119, -1252 to obtain a key.
Use the key on the door in the floor at -1413, 117, -1259. Enter the basement to unlock the discovery.

name: A Wynnic Excavation
lore: The miners soon discovered there were more than emeralds in the walls of this mountain range - Something from out of this world.

steps.text: Go to the end of the Mining Site near the broken bridge that connects to the Ruined Olmic City. There's a long path that goes east under a bridge, loops around South then West, and then goes north over the bridge.
There is a small crystal, click it to activate the discovery.

name: Abandoned Excavations
lore: The drive for emeralds among the Villagers was so great, they excavated nearly all currency in the province. The search for more led the Villagers to explore beyond the sea.

steps.text: Enter the cave and right-click the shovel at the end to obtain it.
Dig up the gravel blocking the entrance to the discovery by right-clicking it with the shovel.

name: Ahmsord's Origins
lore: Much like their other outposts, they Skyraiders were forced to abandon their strongest defence after pressure from the Villager Forces

steps.text: Pick up the Hay Sickle from the crafting table.
Walk over to the hay bales and right click on the particles to dig up the hay.
Enter the hole to trigger the cutscene.

name: Aldwell Library
lore: The great library of Aldwell is used to store texts detailing the ancient history of the village and the surrounding forest, stories that are usually privy only to a select few.

steps.text: The library is at the base of a tree on the west side of Aldwell. Aldwin guards the entrance and asks you to gather four petals around the Mistwoods: talk to him and select "Yes".
The Petal of Altruism is under the white tree east of Aldwell, at -1160, 49, -692.
The Petal of Community is in Aldwell, at -1272, 46, -720.
The Petal of Renewal is inside the fallen tree southwest of Aldwell, at -1354, 52, -615.
The Petal of Resistance is directly south of the Canopy Tree, at -1393, 53, -547.
Return to Aldwin with all four petals and the door opens. Inside are four books on tables, one in each cardinal direction: interact with one and select "Read it".

name: An Unexpected Departure
lore: Desperate to leave the terrible living conditions of the Roughworks, a group a daring inventors created a plan to escape Fruma. They became the first humans settlers on the island of Corkus.

steps.text: Pick up the Old Rake lying against the wall at -1834, 32, -708.
Travel southwest to the statue at -1868, 44, -697. Left-click the ten bushes on the statue while holding the rake to remove them; a ringing sound follows.
Right-click the trapdoor beneath the statue at -1860, 49, -698 and climb down the ladder into a room with a basket at -1860, 37, -692.
Put the three heavy items of the room into the basket: the Petrified Log (-1862, 43, -697), the Heavy Pot (-1867, 38, -698) and the Large Rock (-1858, 30, -700).
With all three inside, the basket falls and opens the floor. Drop through to get the discovery.

name: At the Edge of Decay
lore: Suffering from the cryptic Decay, Northern Gavel is slowly withering away. Its ominous downfall has caused the Villagers of Llevigar to become increasingly superstitious.

steps.text: Collect all scattered four map pieces.
Go to the map and fill in the missing pieces accordingly.

name: Bak'al's Destruction 1
lore: The corrupt entity known as Bak'al has appeared countless times since the portal was opened, decimating everything in his path.

steps.text: Go to the ruins and kill zombies until you get 1 Corrupted Remains.
Drop the Corrupted Remains into the hopper in the ruins.
Follow the path that opens down.

name: Bak'al's Destruction 2
lore: A once great city of Akias was reduced to rubble in 347 AP (After Portal) in one of the largest attacks by Bak'al ever documented. There was only one survivor.

steps.text: Go to the tree and press the wooden button on the tree.
Follow the path until you get to the teleporter.

name: Bak'al's Destruction 3
lore: Just the name of Bak'al is enough to make many cower in fear. They say that wherever he appears, he will only leave death in his wake.

steps.text: Enter the hole near a Phantom Soldier.

name: Beneath the Roots
lore: This cavern is evidence that corruption is like a weed. The roots spread throughout the province.

steps.text: Go to the ruined tower near the Roots of Corruption with several Phantom Soldiers inside.
Go inside and complete the parkour.
At the top of the building, right click to dig.
Collect the Old Key that appears, and head down to the center of the ruins.
Go through the door that opens and jump down the shaft.
Hostile mobs will spawn as you walk through the caverns.

name: Birth of Efilim
lore: No one breaks the utmost laws of Aldorei without exilement. Those who fall in the eyes of the High Elves are banished, never to return. Outcasted from their land, they were forced to find a new home.

steps.text: Interact with the inscribed stone at the shrine to read its poem. To activate the shrine, bring the three fairies of the poem to it.
The Joyful Fairy wanders around Efilim and follows you to the shrine.
Buy Medicinal Herbs from the Medicinal Merchant in Efilim at -1029, 42, -4992.

The Scared Fairy is trapped by fire in the minotaurs' sacrificial pit. Fill the nearby bucket at -957, 45, -5063 with water, put out the flames and heal the fairy with the Medicinal Herbs. Once hearts appear, it follows you to the shrine.
The Lonely Fairy is at a farm just west of Efilim and follows you back to the shrine on its own.
With all three fairies at the shrine, a short cutscene plays and the floor breaks. Jump down and follow the stream to its end for another cutscene.

name: Boulder Breaker
lore: Attacks from the portal were often so brutal, it forced people underground. Sometimes, they never made it back out.

steps.text: Hit the black pile on the wall at 310, 75, -1460 to get a cannonball.
Right-click the cannon with the cannonball and wait for it to destroy the rock. If no message tells you to load the cannon, click around above it.
Go into the hole in the rock.

name: Boulder Pit
lore: The Emperor's 26th son was named Hashr. As he grew older, he became wrought with greed and envy of his father's power. It wasn't long before he was willing to kill.

steps.text: Go to the large boulder located in the Desert and right click it from behind.
Follow the boulder into the pit.

name: Buried Records
lore: Nii, Az, Tol, Uth, Ek. These words of power once held great weight in Fruma, though their meaning has been lost, and only scattered shards of context remain - records fill the shelves, artifacts line the walls, and unfinished carvings lie abandoned on their workstations...

steps.text: Behind the Nasin manor at -937, 153, -1289 is an iced-over river that covers a hole in the ground.
To the North is a tunnel which leads to a cliffside overlooking the Wynn Province. A stela covered in blue cyclones written in both modern Wynnic and the Tahkashtel language can be found here.

Follow the dirt pathway to find an Ice Carver Mole. Kill the Mole, then push the Heavy Ice Block it drops (using spells or main attack) back the trail where you came from originally, it then breaks the ice cover. Alternatively, the Mole can be led to the hole and killed there, so as to reduce the distance needed to push the ice block.
Drop into the hole to unlock the discovery.

name: Canyon Housing
lore: Although the canyon tends to shift and destroy the livelihoods of those who live here, it is not enough to hold back the refugees of the dark forests, preferring the canyon's instability to the Decay.

steps.text: Climb up the ladder to the top of the water wheel.
Cast a spell on the boulder with the white particles. The boulder breaks and you are launched backwards into the water.
Climb back up the wooden path and enter the opening that has appeared. It closes after a while, so be quick.
Walk along the path up the mountain and enter the house at the top, where an old journal lies.

name: Chained Goliaths
lore: Because of their immense power, dragons were captured by dwarves and forced to do their bidding. Currently there is only one known living dragon remaining.

steps.text: Right click the wooden axe to obtain a Dwarven Axe.
Left click on the panel while holding the Dwarven Axe to destroy it.
Wait for the animation to finish, and enter through the lava gateway.

name: Colossal Ruins
lore: Left behind by the Fracturing, this intriguing ruin is thought to have been part of a second Colossus - though it is currently unknown how this one came to be.

steps.text: Use a spell on the rock at 879, 85, -4675.
Go to the ruin on the island in front of you.
Enter the hole made by the rock.

name: Cosmic Crystals
lore: The origins of the colorful crystals is well known, though the power that they hold and their purpose is a mystery that has driven many to the brink of insanity.

steps.text: Use the white blocks to parkour up to the white crystal.
Enter the white crystal to trigger the discovery.

Note: If you stand on the white blocks in the parkour, you will get jump boost. If you stand on the red blocks, you will take damage. If you stand on the blue blocks, you will get pushed around in a circle while remaining on the block.

name: Cracked Canyon
lore: Earthquakes form cracks bursting with mystical energy throughout the canyon. These cracks grow with each quake, and eventually, may lead to a catastrophe.

steps.text: Right-click the bottom of the crane to trigger the cutscene.

name: Crate Crane
lore: Nemract was one of the cities attacked most often. The people would hide in the gutters and sewers until it was over. However, corrupt enemies were not without intelligence, and they were quickly discovered by the enemy.

steps.text: Head to the crane at Nemract.
Press the 'activate' button. If the 'activate' button is absent, press the 'rotate' button once, then press the 'activate' button.
Enter the passage that was behind the crates.

name: Cultural Artefact
lore: Dogun culture flourished before the arrival of the Dwarves. The creators of this massive tablet detailed the history of this most ancient race.

steps.text: Right click the stone tablet to obtain an Ancient Dogun Tablet.
Note the pattern on the sealed door and the tablet. Look for a Dogun house with a similar pattern, and enter it.
Right click the pedestal inside of the house while holding the Ancient Dogun Tablet.
Wait for the cutscene to finish, and bring the Fired Dogun Tablet to where you obtained the original tablet from.
Right click the stone tablet while holding the Fired Dogun Tablet.

name: Decaying Mountains
lore: Creatures residing in mountain caves were forced to search for safer homes down below, after the Decay reached their habitats.

steps.text: Climb the mountain with the help of the jumping pads on the sides of the waterfall.
Enter the cave to activate the Secret Discovery. A Scared Slime NPC can be seem hopping out from the body of water into a small crevice.

name: Desert Royal Residence
requires: All other Desert Secret Discoveries found.
lore: When the sceptre was taken from its master, a curse of sandstorms plagued the empire for years. Nearly everything was buried, even the royal palace.

steps.text: Enter the monument after finding all the other discoveries.

name: Desolate Temples
lore: These temples stand as the last remaining pieces of a native civilization within the Sky Islands, centered around the worship of an ancient, colossal being.

steps.text: Click the statue: a piece of it has been stolen, and the thief may still be nearby.
Walk to this location to spawn the Deranged Swordsman.
Kill the Deranged Swordsman when he turns into a hostile mob; he drops a Mysterious Sword.
Return to the statue and click on it with the Mysterious Sword. Particles play, the floor breaks under you and you fall into a small room, which triggers the discovery.

name: Empty Vaults
lore: Unlike the vast emerald hoards in bank vaults throughout Gavel, Olux's vault has long been empty in its attempt to deal with the Decay.

steps.text: Do the parkour and climb the ladder to reach the top of the chandelier.
Right-click the particles on top of the chandelier to break the chandelier.
Jump into the hole in the floor.

name: Explorer's Corruption Study
lore: Many years ago, a scholar studied how effective Theorick's ice had been so at fighting corruption. Even through the sheer power of the Twains, however, the ice merely slows corruption.

steps.text: Visit the four corruption spikes. The first is at 6, 76, -1047.
The second is at -23, 74, -1012.
The third is at -86, 74, -1008.
The fourth is at -151, 69, -981.
Each time you stand between the spikes, a mob appears: kill it and the spikes freeze. When all are frozen, a hole opens. Go inside.

name: Far Above the Clouds
lore: In times before the Fracturing, stories told of a great wise beast who roamed the lands. As the Ahms region fell, so too did the dragon leave Gavel forever.

steps.text: Near the Sky Castle Entrance, underneath a white dragon statue are some Glowing Bean Sprouts.
Bring them to the empty field near Kandon-Beda.
Place the Glowing Bean Sprouts in the center and then a gigantic beanstalk will grow. Climb the beanstalk to get the discovery.

name: Far From the Roots
lore: Corruption crawls where one can not see. The darkness; the depths; the mind.

steps.text: Kill the Corroded Key item mob on top of the nearby staircase to get a Corroded Key, then right-click the door with it. Continue down the corridor into the Corrupted Passageway.

name: Fate of the Olm
requires: Partial completion of A Journey Further
lore: Many years ago an Olmic oracle foresaw the demise of her land. To prepare for it, she created a weapon of pure light that will halt the darkness, but when the time came to use it, her descendants were unable to retrieve the bracelet.

steps.text: Find the first Stone Tablet in the highest room of the ancient Olmic manor at the north edge of the Ruined City, west of the broken bridge. Its Wynnic text points to the runemaster's basement in the forest. Do every step in order; two players must both do each step.

Go to the only building on the western edge of the Eyeball Forest. On the ruined upper floor, left-click the rope holding the crates on the south side: they fall and open the basement. The second Stone Tablet is on the floor near a table.
Go to the shrine in the northwestern hills of the Toxic Wastes, north of Lutho, under an overhang with green stalactites. This part needs A Journey Further partly done. Collect its three shards.
The Sapphire Shard is atop a partly collapsed pillar at 887, 97, -981.
The Quartz Shard is next to a pillar of the stone pavilion at 925, 90, -983.
The Ebony Shard is in the shadows under a small ledge at 909, 90, -994.

Place the three shards on the altar in the eastern pavilion and jump into the hole that opens. Do the short parkour to the Engraved Stone and interact with it; its text sends you to the family house armory.

Take the Ancient Pickaxe from the pillar left of the engraving, clear the blocked eastern tunnel on the lower level with it, and climb the spiral staircase back up to the Ruined Olmic City, just outside the manor.
In the manor, one player takes Kaen's Key from the altar downstairs at 529, 92, -797...
...and the other takes Adan's Key from the small room with an iron door upstairs at 512, 109, -783.

Both go to the chamber at 519, 100, -744 with two golden pressure plates. At the same time, the player with Kaen's Key stands on the right plate and uses the right keyhole, and the player with Adan's Key does the same on the left.
The doors open to the vault and armory: take the Tomb Key. The third Stone Tablet here says the tomb is north of the manor.

Go up the road north to Anya's tomb and open its door with the Tomb Key (one player is enough now). Reach the grave at the end of the hallway to complete the discovery. Press the button on the grave and click Anya's corpse for Anya's Penumbra, a Fabled bracelet.

name: First Wicker's Spark
lore: The clandestine Fort Hegea was built over the remnants of an ancient gathering spot for the clans. Its construction was ordered as punishment - of the clans over the fervor of many, of the changelings over the error of one.

steps.text: At -1111, 105, -775 is a note on how to make a wicker man, with a platform for it in front.
Take the Small TNT from a shelf at -1075, 111, -768.
Use the TNT on the boulder at the shooting range at -1106, 103, -698. Four piles of rocks appear across the range.
First pile of rocks: -1099, 103, -697.
At -1105, 101, -697 is a small brooch: interact with it to see a memory.
At -1060, 109, -711 are a Hay Bundle and four Timber Framings; the small pendant beneath them holds another memory.
At -1066, 110, -744 are four Pine Framings.
On the platform, place the Rubble-Rocks in the marked circles and the bed of hay on the orange stand in the middle.
Interact with the crate at -1106, 106, -781 to build the scaffold; you get two Lumber Framings.
Place all the framings on the wicker man to finish it.
Pick up the lit candle near the shooting range at -1118, 103, -699, which shows a memory, and light the wicker man with it.

name: Fracture in Reality
lore: When the runes were combined ages ago, the Forgery burst from the ground. Sealed by its anchors is a mysterious fracture in space and time from which the structure draws its power.

steps.text: In order to reach the achievement, the player must activate and complete a parkour course starting at one of the chains securing the Forgery to the ground.
Approach the bases of both chains and use any spell close to the particles. Doing this will activate the parkour.
Make your way up with the help of the newly appeared platforms.
Reaching the end of the parkour will teleport you to the site of the discovery.
Exit by walking into the white portal.

name: Frozen Cave Hideout
lore: Families like these used to hide underground during raids. In the final raid of Nesaak, Theorick froze the entire place over - freezing them with it.

steps.text: Climb the mountain by following the stone buttons behind the southern statue leg.
Click the wooden button located on the statue's hand near the spear.
Quickly make your way to the northern statue by climbing the spear and using your movement spell, then click the wooden button on the northern statue's spear too.
When the spears make a shape of an upside-down 'v', make your way towards the base of the southern statue. You will notice that it has raised its foot, quickly enter the gap created.

name: Gavel Excavation
lore: Upon discovering the meteors below Lake Gylia, a company dedicated to their collection and observation was established. Eventually, however, their focus shifted towards Wynn.

steps.text: There will be 2 different sections of the Garden, both of which are near-mirror images of the other. To reach it, do some parkour and get to the top of the aquifer, and then to the left or right of it (Depends on the side), there will be a bulky white lever. Jump on the lever to register it, and do the same for the opposite side. After that, both aquifers will then pour water into a small fountain. This will then reveal a secret entrance beneath each fountain. Enter it to register the Discovery.

name: Gylia Watch Library
requires: Hunger of the Gerts Part I
lore: These are the only remaining records that describe the events of the Gerten War. However, history was written by the victors.

steps.text: To gain access to the library the player has to search for and find a key hidden in the Gert camp that is being watched by the Gylia Watch. Entering the Gert camp requires the player to equip the Hungry Gert Mask given as a reward for completing the quest Hunger of the Gerts Part I.
Reach the tower overlooking the Gert camp and climb the ladder to the top. Collect the key.
Head back to the Gylia Watchtower and descend into the basement. Use the key on the wall.
Enter the opened tunnel, this will trigger the teleport to the library itself.

name: Gylia's Cataclysm
requires: All other Gylia Plains Secret Discoveries found
lore: More than two thousand years ago, two meteors crashed down into the Gylia Plains. Over centuries, the crater filled to become a lake where the most curious magic circulates.

steps.text: Head to Lake Gylia and go into the underground cave marked by a small gate. Head down the cave, jump into the water and go to the purple particles between two spikes in the middle of the room to trigger the cutscene.

name: Hallowed Ground
lore: The mythical waters of the Lazarus Pit affect corpses in different ways. Some resurrect with part of their memories intact. Some return as nothing but husks of their former selves.

steps.text: Find the head of Revan by the tree at the top of the graveyard.
Interacting with the various graves around the graveyard will prompt some dialogue from Revan with clues for the location of his grave.
Approach the center wooden floor.
Jump down the hole in the floor.

name: Harmless Worms
lore: The Grootslangs are peaceful creatures who live deep underground. It was long thought they were extinct as they have not been seen in centuries. Recently, something has driven them upwards.

steps.text: There is a boulder being held up by wooden supports.
Head to the left of the cave to find the Explosive.

Use the explosive on the support beams. A cave in will occur and you will get teleported to the secret discovery. Within the cave, a large grootslang can be seen crawling through tunnels. Going through either hole the grootslang crawled through brings you back out.

name: Headless, Not Homeless
requires: Started Realm of Light III - A Headless History
lore: Shortly after his revival, Dullahan set his sights on the manor of a wealthy Villager, slaughtering everyone in his sight. To this day, the castle remains under his control.

steps.text: A short door puzzle leads to where the memory starts. Enter the tower right of the entrance to Dullahan's mansion.
Cross the stairs and turn left, then take the entrance around the tower corner.
Turn left from the balcony and follow the blood trail to the next door.
Interact with the skeletal remains at -1064, 99, -5594 to see a lost memory.

name: Hidden in Plain Sight
lore: Abandoned are the old tunnels and railways that lay beneath the earth. Though humanity no longer uses them, the new inhabitants have made these rusting railways their home.

steps.text: At -2167, 47, -655 a raccoon runs in circles. Talk to it.
Pick up the seeds at -2181, 51, -658, bring them to the raccoon and select "Give seeds.".
Once fed, the raccoon runs off and reveals a hole to the discovery at -2167, 47, -655.

name: Historical Maltic
lore: Maltic was the first settlement ever made by the arriving villagers. The alliance between Villagers and Humans would go on to save the province.

steps.text: Parkour your way up to the top by following the red carpets.
There will be an anvil at the top hanging in the center, jump into it multiple times to drop it.
It will crush the floor opening a secret base, enter it.

name: Life Before Technology
lore: The land now called the Roughworks used to be dedicated almost entirely to farming. One day, however, a young prodigy constructed an invention to help her; one which would change the region forever...

steps.text: Pick up the Dulled Blade sitting in the small depression in the floor.

Parkour or use movement spells to get onto the dark oak platform, and cut the ropes holding it up by right clicking with the Dulled Blade. The platform will come crashing down and fill up the small pit, allowing access across for the next stage.

Next, find the empty wooden bucket inside the house. The block should have a thin outline surrounding it, with instructions above it telling you to left click to push, and right click to undo the previous action. Push the bucket across the dark oak platform and over to -1636, 30, -526, which should be directly under the spout of dripping water.

Find the red water valve and right click it to turn it on. Right clicking it will send a stream of water particles raining down from the spout onto the block below. If the bucket is in the correct spot, it will fill with water, and you will receive the filled water bucket item in your inventory.
Across from the water valve, there is a brick fireplace. If you have the bucket in your inventory, the fireplace will be extinguished, and you will be able to pick up the key laying within it.
Take the key to the keyhole and interact with it: the door opens. Walk a little into the hallway to unlock the discovery.
Afterwards, topple a bookshelf to open the exit. The discovery stays open for later visits.

name: Light and Shadow
lore: The leader of the Canopy is a Changeling and was part of the original group of Changelings discovered alongside Sovereign Gikyo. However, Azael took a very different path from his sibling.

steps.text: At -1388, 168, -562 in the Canopy's base is a room containing three pedestals. All of them can be read, which displays words in Tahkashtel.
Obtain three nearby masks to open the trapdoor and access the hidden chamber:
The Ritual Fox Mask is found at -1392, 142, -549, and should be placed on the East (/Fox) pedestal.
The Ritual Deer Mask is found at -1378, 171, -568, and should be placed on the South (/Deer) pedestal.
The Ritual Owl Mask is found at -1381, 190, -569, and should be placed on the West (/Owl) pedestal.
Once all masks have been placed onto their pedestals, the trapdoor in the middle will open. Enter the room to complete the discovery.

name: Light Mushrooms
lore: These strange mushrooms spread across the Light forest are enveloped in mystery. Their forms are incredibly interchangeable, and their effects on people are even more enigmatic.

steps.text: Opening the entrance to the discovery will require the player to complete a short color puzzle.
Collect 2 purple spores, 1 blue spore, and 1 red spore from the mushrooms west of the area.
Color the white mushrooms purple.
Color the blue mushroom red.
Color the orange mushroom blue.
A hole will open in the ground at the roots of the purple mushroom, jump down the entrance.

name: Llevigar's Last Hope
requires: All other Llevigar Plains Secret Discoveries found
lore: For centuries, Gavel was a peaceful place. As time has gone on, increasingly devastating events have plagued the province. Out of a need to survive and expand, the Villagers looked elsewhere for hope...

steps.text: Head to the structure and stand in the center of it.

name: Llevigar's Secret Library
lore: This mystical library holds Llevigar's most fascinating, and dangerous books. From guides on cosmic magic to wise dragons of old, this is certainly a place to spend many hours inside.

steps.text: Three books are scattered around the public Library.
First Chronicles of Siegfried: -1860, -4492.
Second Edition of "Achievements of Siegfried": -1867, -4507.
Third Tome of Llevigar's History: -1862, -4521.
With all three, go to the room at -1855, -4543 and put each book on the shelf with its number. A bookshelf on the west side opens a hidden room with the Dusty Key.
Use the Dusty Key on the bookshelf with a keylock at -1849, -4503 to open Llevigar's Secret Library.

name: Loot of the Lost
lore: Many lose their lives to the canyon, yet their belongings are never to be found. A certain group of hobgoblins collect and hoard all that they can find.

steps.text: Climb the ladder and walk along the path up the tree.
Click the chest at the top to get a peculiar key.
Go to the vault door and click it with the key, then walk into the treasure room to trigger the discovery. The vault stays open afterwards.

name: Lost Avos City
lore: The history of the Avos has remained largely unknown, but this monument of Avos ancestry might hold the ancient secrets that historians have been looking for.

steps.text: Unlike most Avos settlements and homes, there is one abandoned Avos hut outside of the Avos Territory, on the ground level mostly dominated by the Corkian Humans. This site is mentioned as unusual by a Corkus Citizen in Corkus City.

To begin the process of finding the Lost City, just enter this hut (be wary of the many hostile rogue Mechs that spawn nearby, as you could get trapped inside by them). A ghostly Avos simply called ??? will appear behind you, in the doorway; right-clicking it will cause it to vanish and reappear some distance away, to the north. Keep following this ghost north, right-clicking it each time to make it appear at its next location, until you reach a cave in the cliffs.

This cave is also full of dangerous mobs, so be prepared to fight them off. After interacting with the Avos ghost at the cave entrance, follow it twice more into a large room with a ledge, where it will now be found. This chamber also holds two Tier III Loot Chests. Right-click the ghost one more time to make it disappear and open a secret passage in the wall, which will teleport you to the subterranean Lost Avos City. Simply walk forward to achieve the Discovery, and gain 1060000 experience points.

name: Lost Farmers
lore: Unable to travel safely, farmers in Olux generally live a lonely life. Few people noticed when they began to disappear.

steps.text: Go to the house at -1981, 56, -5267.
Break the window of the house.

name: Lusuco's Secret Library
lore: This old library has been slumbering beneath Lusuco for years. It tells the story of the legendary Twain children.

steps.text: Obtain 5 Gunpowder
Purchase 1 Dynamite from the Explosives Shop
Drop the Dynamite on the gray carpet at [-193, 28, -302]
Enter the entrance that opened up in the ice wall.

name: Maex Black Market
lore: Dwarven society is not all it's cracked up to be. In this sleazy black market, every product here is illegal in some way, though most of these criminals are only trying to survive royal austerity.

steps.text: Approach the area at the above coordinates (pictured below) and speak to the Phoenix Poacher.
Follow the Phoenix Poacher until he leaves a piece of pottery behind.
Right click the pottery to obtain Fine Pottery.
Go to Maex with the Fine Pottery and speak to the Shopkeeper.
Enter through the door behind the Shopkeeper.

name: Mark of the Meteors
lore: The Crashing of the Sky, as they called it, impacted the lives of Gylia in many ways - Even after centuries of its occurrence.

steps.text: Left-click the supports on the boulder, the boulder will the roll down to the coordinates [-117, 31, -5502], where a hole will appear in the ground. Enter the hole to register the discovery.

name: Messengers From Beyond
lore: The Light has endless ways to communicate with the inhabitants of Gavel. One such way is through physical beings, from a higher level of existence.

steps.text: You need the Strange Coin found next to Elder Berusia at the end of Shattered Minds.
Reach the end of the cave and click the NPC with the coin in hand: a path opens.
Go through the door to trigger the discovery.

name: Mining Cessation
lore: Simple emerald mining turned to disaster as they broke through into the Silent Expanse. In a final act to protect the province, they barricaded themselves in, and sealed their fate.

steps.text: Click the button to activate the Thrower and it will blow the obstacle to let the water through.
Mine the Boulder with a pickaxe (Mining level 10 needed) to open a hole that lets the water through.
Click the button to activate the Water Controller, it will let the water in the hole with lava and it will create a small parkour course.
Enter the small hole at the end of the water trail.

name: Mining Operation
lore: The mysteries uncovered from this excavation were quickly abandoned as an ancient dark force, one far more dangerous than anything this province has encountered, was found to be lurking beyond Wynn's southern border.

steps.text: Press the button on the crane.
Press the button on the cart.
Climb the ladder of a wooden transport crane and press the button on its platform.
Press the button on the ground level of the other end of the crane.
Follow the TNT-minecart, that appears on the Rails, to the mines in the South.
Press the button to the left.
Enter the cavern opened by the blast of TNT.

name: Ne du Valeos du Ellach
requires: All other Light Forest Secret Discoveries found.
lore: Before time, it began. Through the ages it ravaged the lands. Another day, another night, it continues in the worlds beyond. Forever it shall last.

steps.text: Once every other Light Forest secret discovery is found, enter the shrine to start the cutscene.

name: Necklace Chamber
lore: Long ago, the Avos hid away a powerful necklace. Despite the many tales and legends of it, it has never been located until now.

steps.text: In the building at -1877, 125, -3087 (Avos Camp), right-click the enchanting table on the right wall with a Golden Avia Feather. A particle trail leads to a pillar in the Avos Chief's hut, which breaks to reveal stairs down to the Tale of the Lost Necklace.

Stage 2, in the cliff at -1876, 115, -3377: step on all three pressure plates in the hanging cages quickly one after another. A hole opens by the easternmost cage; jump in, follow the cave to a tent opening on your left, go towards the signs and press the button at the end to open the exit.

Stage 3, on a mountain top at -1435, 152, -3318: have the Grandmaster Shaman make a land bridge (needs The Envoy Part II up to stage 4), jump down the spring on top of the pillar and follow the cave. A tripwire opens the wall to invisible parkour over water (sea lanterns mark the blocks). Kill the Orb of the Water Winds at the end; it drops itself as an item.

Stage 4, at the altar at -1197, 36, -3327: right-click the enchanting table with the orb and wait to be teleported. In the cave, light up all the lights: from left to right, hit the 4th, 5th, 6th and 9th plates.

Stage 5: enter the lighthouse at -1321, 118, -2994 and go to the lower section at the east end, with holes in the west wall. Collect 3 blood items in the cave, then quickly drop one on each spike block without blood to break a wall and reveal a teleport.
The long cave behind it has some parkour and Ancient Avos Assassins. Answer its quiz: The Avos / In a cave with cages / 4 / 3 / Orb of the Water Winds.
A door opens to the Necklace Chamber: enter it for the discovery, and walk next to the middle pedestal for the Fabled Necklace of a Thousand Storms.

name: Nilrem's Sealed Letter
lore: An ancient letter addressed to Bob's friend Nilrem regarding a dark power...

steps.text: Get two Mysterious Keys at -195, 80, -642 or -187, 76, -731.
Go to the north door at -209, 68, -784 use the key by right clicking the door.
Enter the tower and stand at the golden pressure plate that will push you up to get to the end of the tower.
There is an iron pressure plate, stand on it to weaken Nilrem's spell.
Do the same thing with the south door at -209, 75, -608 to completely break the spell.
A hole will open at -208, 62, -694 enter the hole.

name: Otherworldly Occurrence
lore: The connection between our world and other realms has been shattered and warped as the war of corruption evolved.

steps.text: Four eyeballs on fences around the area point at a gray concrete block. Visit one of the eyes first, or the hole may not open.
Stand on the block at 921, 79, -470 for 5 to 15 seconds and the hole opens.

name: Otherworldly Origins
lore: Despite being a popular household pet, no one really knows the true origins of Wybels. Some theorize they fell from space, but such claims are often dismissed as conspiracy theories.

steps.text: Enter the cave and get the Strange Device
Use the Strange Device to open the trapdoor
Right-click on the screen at the front of the room to activate the cutscene.

name: Parasite Cocoon
lore: After a battle with a powerful Elf, the creature that broke into this realm had to recoup its strength. It therefore hibernated in an unknown underground location for many years...

steps.text: A decay spike has broken through the wall of a house at -1347, 45, -5498. It has weakened, and something sharp nearby could cut it down.
Enter the house and go up the staircase to the second floor.
Exit through the east window and follow the trail of decayed shrubs.
Break the window, enter the attic and walk to the end of the corridor.
Collect the rusted scythe.
Go back to the decay spike and punch it until it breaks.
Proceed through the tunnel.

name: Pottery Wheel
lore: Theorick was the principal defender of the Nesaak region for many years. The inhabitants volunteered contributions to him, sometimes in gratitude, sometimes in fear. He also loved to make pottery.

steps.text: There is a pottery wheel up the mountain starting at -212, 41, -488. Bring some clay from a crate close by to activate the pottery wheel.

name: Quicksand
lore: The civilization that ruled this land over 1500 years ago seemed to be equally as educated as people today. There are lots of texts dedicated to the Emperor.

steps.text: Jump into the pit of sand near the warning sign to enter the ruins.

name: Ragni's Secret Library
lore: A twelve-volume story of Wynn's great hero can be found here. The origins of this library, and others like it, still remain unknown.

steps.text: Drop 1 Bob's Tear in the center of the fireplace in Ragni's Castle.
Follow the shadow until it opens the gate of the castle painting in the feast hall.

name: Relos' Secret Library
lore: This library tells a tale that the government of Corkus has kept secret. Rumors tell that more mysterious libraries like this one are hidden across the world.

steps.text: The sealed entrance to the library is located in an isolated house in Relos, high on the northern cliffs. Inside, the Relos Mechanic stands near a hopper in the floor connected to large pieces of machinery throughout the room. She says that this abandoned workshop has very archaic machinery, but that the mechanism the hopper is attached to might give some answers, but the workshop is drained of electromagical energy. Luckily, the system can be restored using an Electromagical Battery.

The only battery accessible to the player is located in Corkus Docks, hidden at the very top of the mast of the large ship docked there. There are several ways to reach it; by climbing the rigging, using movement spells like teleport, escape or vanish, or by jumping down from the high cliffs above. A level zero Electromagical Battery mob is located there, which can be killed to receive the required item.

After returning to the Relos workshop with the battery, use right-click to place into a holder. Activate the lights and machinery inside to open up the small door on the far wall, gaining access to the library.

name: Remains of the Cursed
lore: So long as Her Majesty reigns over Fruma, those decreed Cursed will plot to rebel against her. One particular group found great success by using a concept coincidentally rediscovered for the War beyond Fruma's walls — assigning its members a "class" of weapon.

steps.text: At -1733, 26, -1292 is a thunder-based weapon with green particles emanating from it. Interact with the weapon to pick it up.
A cutscene plays; then a figure in a yellow robe leads you into a cave with a blue door, which opens. Talk to the figure.
Enter the door to reach a hideout.

name: Ruins of Detlas
lore: The modern city of Detlas was built with the help of villagers after their arrival in Wynn, but these ruins might hold the secrets of what lied before.

steps.text: Go to Detlas and enter the house with a Cooking Station right outside of it.
Go upstairs and climb up the ladder. Go through one of the windows located at the north side of the attic and go across the blue banners to the Phantom Soldier.
Enter the house at the other side through the window and jump down the platforms located inside

Drop down the hole that opens at the bottom and keep following the path until you get to the Fountain Control Valve. Interact with the wheel and wait until a message appears, saying: "Activating this device must have activated something on the surface..."
Go to the exit on the left. Upon exiting, you end up in a basement with the Basement Dweller. Head on up, you'll find a secret hatch leading into a house.

After exiting the house go across the main plaza towards the Black Road and turn left right in front of the main gate and go to the fountain. After the water disappears, go into the hole that opens up.

name: Ruler of the Skies
lore: The Skyraiders were known for their domination over the Sky Islands. As the Villagers adapted to the land, the Skyraiders' dominion faded.

steps.text: Climb up the vines to access the base of the tower.
Walk up the stairs and walk up to the airship. Right click on the particles to break the rope and let the airship fly towards the wall.
Go up the scaffolding and enter the hole the airship made.

name: Rymek Thief
lore: After being kicked out of the Wynn cities during the Corruption War, a growing number of bandits began to reassimilate in the desert and mesa.

steps.text: Go to the merchant's stand and right-click the particles to start the event; you get 7 Emeralds that do not stack with regular ones.
Follow the ??? bandit into the cave and down the path to the room with the Bandit Leader and Bandit Guards.
Leave the room: the Bandit Leader goes on talking, then the bandits take you out of the hideout and steal the 7 Emeralds.

name: Sealed Away
lore: Whatever lies beyond the barrier of the Great Stump has long been forgotten. Any attempts to enter it have been made with no success.

steps.text: Right-clicking the Seas Lantern in the cave will trigger a cutscene showing Lari attempting to get past the barrier to the portal to the Realm of Light.

name: Sealed in Ice
lore: A scar of the Dogun War. The freezing of this Dogun city left most of its old residents sealed with it, to be forgotten.

steps.text: Click the rubble with any pickaxe.
Follow the lava flow until it reaches the frozen Dogun.

name: Shadowy Dealings
lore: The highly valued guard golems are quite effective in repelling danger, but they are not enough to help the citizens of Olux. Desperation is the only choice for many.

steps.text: There's a Golem Command Chip on the table inside the Golem Maintenance house in Olux.
Head to the Olux Lumberyard and right-click on the Olux Guard Golem with the Golem Command Chip in your hand
Lead the golem to the saw.
The saw will reveal a cave that you can access.

name: Shrouded Lives
lore: When those who worked at the secretive factory returned home, none would speak of their experiences inside of it.

steps.text: In the cave at -1900, 64, -5465 is a trapdoor held shut by water pressure.
Next go to the basement of the house nearby. Press the lever marked "Reverse input/output" and then hit the button labeled "Activate pump".
Go to the hole and click on the door.

name: Silent Expanse's Secret
requires: All other Silent Expanse Discoveries found
lore: The Silent Expanse has acted as the gateway to Dern since the outbreak of the Corruption War. The Eye has watched all intruders.. and all attempts at escape.

steps.text: Enter the tower at 1372, 87, -687 after completing all the Silent Expanse discoveries.
Climb the stairs all the way up and stand at 1372, 132, -702.

name: Solace in Pain
lore: Sovereigns of the province harbor unimaginable power. To some, the pain inflicted upon themselves to reach these heights is nothing but anecdotal. To others, not to all.

steps.text: In the east of Espren is the entrance to Sovereign Zhiraok's manor, with two Espren Guards, a Gardener and an Espren Citizen around it. First talk to the Gardener or the Espren Citizen.
For the Espren Citizen, select "What is this place?", then "Feel watched?". For the Gardener, select "I have something to report.", then "I have something else to report.".

Then talk to one of the Espren Guards: select "I have something to report.", then "I saw a cursed one in town!", then "There's someone trying to sneak into the mansion." (Manor Guard) or "Someone started mocking our Queen." (Garden Guard).

Both guards leave the garden for a while. Sneak into Zhiraok's mansion: from the bench, follow the green particles through the treetops and bounce off the red leaves to the balcony. If you are too slow, the guards come back and you start over.

name: Somewhere In Between
lore: The Pigmen are a mysterious creature, neither pig nor man, neither corrupt nor whole.

steps.text: Complete the parkour marked by brown carpet.
Press the wooden button at the top, located right above the tunnel entrance where the track emerges.
Enter the tunnel opened by the TNT.

name: Space Between Realities
lore: Between Realms of physicality and influence lies the vast nothingness of the void. Some islands have broken from the land and drifts in this space, seeking purpose.

steps.text: Go to the path at 1140, 78, -974.
Follow the path to the mountain in Void Valley (1077, 109, -1058), then take a right at the next path.
Jump into the Void Hole at 1178, 137, -1082.

name: Spider Ruins
lore: Many inexplicable ancient temples are scattered throughout Gavel, but some of these ruins have been wiped out by the Villagers as they sought to expand. Only a few remain to this day.

steps.text: Chop all the trees of the grove (18). Each of them will make a special noise and emit particles when broken.
The area will then get filled with leaves and a hole will appear on the floor.
Jump in the hole to discover the Spider Ruins.

name: Subterranean Creation
lore: Long ago, the lower levels of Molten Heights were a mere cave system. Using their ancient magic, the Doguns carved out these caves into vast structures.

steps.text: Approach the steaming geyser at 1235, 46, -5473.
After you jump into a geyser, another one will start steaming nearby. Keep jumping into them until you reach the big geyser to the east.
Wait for the big geyser to shoot you through the ceiling into the upper level, and aim for the hole.
Once you land, enter through the rock that has collapsed.

name: Summoner's Fate
lore: The Decay was bad news for the citizens of Gavel. However, it became a haven for amateur warlocks to practice dark magic... poorly.

steps.text: In order to activate the altar you will need to gather four different items.
Kill the Newborn Cow at the Honest Farm Co. next to Gelibord.
Collect the Vial of Blood at the center of Gelibord.
Collect the Magical Tome in the first stone house to the right after crossing the bridge to Gelibord's Castle.
Kill the Summoned Rift in front of Referick's house from the quest Realm of Light III - A Headless History.
Place the items on their respective altars (the four pieces of stone north, east, south and west of the altar with purple smoke).

name: Sunken Monument
lore: The Queen claims that, prior to her arrival, Fruma was ruled by mayhem and disorder, and that none could live in peace without her protection. Yet, as sites such as this seem to show, a different culture once flourished in these lands, with their own beliefs and customs now lost forever.

steps.text: Collect the three coiled stones hidden in the aristocratic Highland mansions.
The first coiled stone is found in Liftal Castle at -1449, 170, -1094
The second coiled stone is found in Estalis Gallery at -1301, 105, -879
The third coiled stone is found in Krisa Manor at -1325, 121, -1008
Piecing together the numbers in each stone's lore reveals the coordinates -1541, 72, -1231, found inside of Lake Gitephe under an arch.
Enter the cave and place the three stones on the door to unlock the discovery.

name: Teachings of Old
lore: The history and culture of the Villagers were shaped by magic. Their unusual ways of converting such power to everyday chores was common, but some of these learnings have now been long forgotten by the public.

steps.text: To begin the discovery, speak to the fisherman inside his house. It is located just north of Bucie along the river.
Grab a fishing rod from the shelf and follow the fisherman outside to continue.
To advance in the discovery, it is required to catch at least 8 fish. Should you catch less than 8 fish, speak to the fisherman again inside his house to try again.
If you catch 8 or more fish, you receive a Prismarine Gadget.
Head south along the river and fill the gadget with water at about -1470, -4833.
Place the filled gadget in the irrigation system west of the fisherman's house: an animation plays and a hole opens south-west of the sprinkler. Enter it for the discovery.

name: Temple of Light
lore: The Elves attempted to convince the Villagers to worship the Light. The religion never took hold and thus these temples were abandoned.

steps.text: Unlocking the door to the temple requires the player to complete a short puzzle.
The player needs to redirect reflections of light to reach the door.
Redirect the first mirror so that it's directed towards the door.
Direct the other mirrors to allow the light to travel to the unlit lamp in the door.

name: Temple of Swords
lore: After realizing its true power, Hashr realized he must hide the sceptre where no one can find it. Many years later, a group of bandits found refuge in this very temple.

steps.text: Head into the temple and behind the statues should be a short tunnel to a sword; right-click it.
Place the sword into the slot in front of the statue.
Turn the sword in accordance with the statues above, making sure to hit the head at each sync.
Enter the revealed entrance and continue along with the dialogue.

name: Temple Ruin
lore: The Emperor's Sceptre is a mysterious artifact that gave the holder unquestionable power. The people of the Desert Empire constructed temples to honor it.

steps.text: Go to the mound behind the Cactus Expert's building and left-click the machete at 1036, -1827.
Left click the cacti with the Machete and jump down into the uncovered hole.

name: Thanos Armory
lore: Hidden in the depths of Thanos is a legendary forge. This armoury is where weapons of dragon slaying potential were forged; however, they are no longer to be seen within it.

steps.text: Right-click the pipe behind Syni's tent.
Once the lava is flowing, climb the ladder on the right of the pipe to the top, and right-click the red stained glass to pick it up.
Right-click the empty spot with the lava tank and wait for the door to open, then enter the discovery room.

name: The Ancient Ones
lore: These ancients beings are the enigma of Gylia Plains. Their strange structure has deterred many historians from from finding the answer to one question - were they beast or stone?

steps.text: At -118, 39, -4686, right-click the lone golem head by the blue stones to get a Ruined Golem Head.
Find the headless golem and climb its east shoulder.
Right click to re-attach the head. This will throw you in front of the golem.
Enter the golem's opened chest.

name: The Bane of Gavel
requires: All other Olux Swamp Secret Discoveries found
lore: Below the forests, far from the eyes of Villagers, lies the terrible truth of the Decay...

steps.text: Head to the structure and stand in the center of it.

name: The Broken Protector
requires: All other Canyon of the Lost Secret Discoveries found
lore: The Canyon Colossus wasn't always a threat to its environment. But as the years went on, something seems to have sent the powerful mechanisms of this ancient being haywire.

steps.text: Head to the ruins in the Canyon of the Lost at 213, -4935. Wait for the orb to spin and then the Cutscene will start.

name: The Doguns' Defeat
requires: All other Molten Heights Secret Discoveries found
lore: For years the Doguns fought for their land, but eventually every war must have a victor, although no one is a winner.

steps.text: Head east from Rodoroc, go right, and follow the path until you find a ruined village. Stand in the large stone structure.

name: The Fallen Protector
requires: All other Sky Islands Secret Discoveries found
lore: Long ago, a Colossus once inhabited the Ahms Region before its fracturing. With nobody to keep the being's mechanisms in check, it eventually went haywire and shattered the entire region.

steps.text: Head to the temple in the Sky Islands at 1230, 140, -4689. Wait for the orb to spin and then the Cutscene will start.

name: The Final Moments
requires: Partial completion of A Journey Beyond
lore: Shortly after the portal broke into this hidden land, a beast from an unknown realm laid siege to the city forcing the Olm to its domain.

steps.text: After entering the bottom floor of the observatory, a trail of blood leads up the central spiral staircase and through the subsequent empty floors. Continue climbing the ladders through the structure until reaching the highest domed chamber.
Inside is a raised platform with a telescope pointed out at the sky to the east. Approaching the eyepiece of the telescope will trigger a cutscene.

name: The Forest has Eyes
lore: For every miner in Lutho that lost contact with their inner self, two eyes grow from the trees.

steps.text: Climb to the top of the Eyeball Tree. Along the way, you'll notice small eyeballs. Left click them to activate a bridge to continue climbing.
As you stand near the top of the tree, a short section of parkour will appear allowing you access to the eyeball atop the tree. Enter the eyeball.

name: The Grand Archive
lore: This magnificent library holds some of the oldest pieces of literature known to the world. However, not all scriptures have been archived in these halls...

steps.text: Right-click the purple flameholder in the Cinfras Guild Hall to pick it up.
A bit further, on the wall to the left, there are a few platforms. Parkour up these platforms and climb the three ladders.
In the room at the top of the tower, right-click the wooden wall with the flameholder and enter the space that opens up.
The exit is at the bottom of the Grand Archives.

name: The Great Barrier
lore: The parasitic creatures are unable to invade the canyon due to a strange force that keeps the mountains in an endless motion.

steps.text: Go to these coordinates and walk past the side of the sandstone ruins to the back. This triggers a cutscene showing the Secret Discovery.

name: The Great Sap Siphon
lore: The Industrial District is one big factory; every element of it meticulously designed to output produce for the rest of the province at maximum efficiency. Even the trees exist only to manufacture.

steps.text: Pick up the Old Scraper at -1978, 28, -627 and use it on the pipe clogged with hardened sap at -2003, 25, -636; it breaks and lets you into the building.
Fill each vat to its level (A 9, B 6, C 3) with the buttons on the second floor. One way: fill B, B→A, fill C, C→A, C→B, A→C, empty C, B→C, A→B, fill A, A→B, empty B, A→B, fill A.
The engine at the back explodes and opens a hole: walk through it to unlock the discovery.

name: The Heart of the Decay
requires: All other Dark Forest Discoveries found.
lore: For two hundred years the nest of the parasitic creatures remained hidden. It released countless Dark leeches into the undergrowth of the province. By the time it was found, it was already too late.

steps.text: Approaching the root of the tree stump will prompt the hidden entrance to open.

name: The Lone Telescope
lore: The large crystal floating above the Tower of Ascension was not of earthly origins. While powerful, the strange magical aura it exudes has caused various strange happenings in the surrounding region.

steps.text: Use the Telescope.

name: The Lonely Abyss
lore: The Void is a limitless expanse transcending the concepts of space, time, and reality itself. Those who are stranded within its abyss are left to wander its boundless depths for eternity.

steps.text: Jump down onto the island.
Kill the 9 Void Infantries that spawn to trigger the cutscene.
In the cutscene you will be launched backwards into the void, experiencing its boundless depths. After a few seconds, you will return to one of the void islands you were on earlier.

name: The Royal University's Library
lore: The Aelumia University's library is home to a vast wealth of information. Though it should be taken with a grain of salt, there is much to learn from its books.

steps.text: At -1722, 140, -735 is a door guarded by two University Guards. Trying to enter without a Library Permission Slip will push you away from the door.
To obtain a permission slip, a Nonogram puzzle must be completed using the gardening tools at -1701, 140, -745.

name: The Talor Crypt
lore: Crypts such as these were commonly used to bury the richest in the area. However, the Decay's aggressive nature resulted in these crypts being overfilled with corpses, and eventually abandoned.

steps.text: Climb the cathedral organ and follow the green carpets out the window.
Continue following the carpets, parkouring up the side of the cathedral until you reach the bell up in the bell tower.
Climb onto the bell and interact with the green particles.
Jump through the broken floor.

name: The Twains' Downfall
requires: All other Nesaak Tundra Secret Discoveries found.
lore: With the death of Marius Twain, the family fell apart, leaving Wynn's protectors alone... or worse.

steps.text: Go to the Twain Lake and stand in the structure.

name: Timeless Ruin
lore: The people who built these mysterious structures had unusual control over time magic. Very few alive understand it or know about the people who lived here, for they were neither Human nor Villager. A species that fled the plains thousands of years ago.

steps.text: Go to the ruined temple in Time Valley
Go inside the temple and kill the Mysterious Gem, which will drop 1 Mysterious Gem
Head over to the ruins in Time Valley
There is a blood trail leading to one of the ruins
Complete the Parkour by following the grey and green carpets.
Right click the grey glass block with a smaller red glass block inside to place the Mysterious Gem.
Go to the center of the ruins and jump down into the hole that has opened.

name: Tomb of the Founders
lore: Commanding the battalions of Molten Heights to victory, these two revered Dwarven leaders' likeness inspire all those who enter through this gate.

steps.text: Right click the burning branch to obtain a Kindled Branch.
Next, climb up on top of the two large statues. Use the nearby steaming geysers to get up there.
Right click all four of the statues' eye sockets with the Kindled Branch.

name: Torn in Twain
lore: Of the Twains, Theorick had a different idea of how defending the province should look and the rights that gave the defender. Eventually these differences lead to him breaking off from the family to found his own land.

steps.text: Go to 31, 68, -280. There is a rock within the stream which you can climb onto. Go in front of the rock and it will send you up the waterfall.
There is a rock stuck at 39, 140, -246. Go near it to activate the discovery.

name: Totem Pole
lore: Following the death of the Emperor, sandstorms raged across the land, and the Eagle Tribe was forced to take refuge in an abandoned prayer cave.

steps.text: Talk to the Eagle Tribesman.
Go to the Owl Tribe and enter one of the houses. In it there should be particles coming off of the Wooden Eye. Right Click it to get it.
Go back to the Eagle Tribe and go back to the Eagle Tribesman. Climb up the mountain to the left following the stone path. Jump on to the top of the totem's head and place the eye in the empty spot.
Follow the Totem's arm towards a cave and go inside.

name: Toxic Bounce
lore: The land influenced by Dern can manifest in many ways, here a monster and landscape merged to become one sentient creature.

steps.text: Kill the Explosive Beast to get an Explosive Heart. The Explosive Beast spawns around [1013, 71, -1025].
Go to the slime pit and use the Explosive Heart at [1022, 40, -971].
Enter the hole at [1022, 57, -977].

name: Unstable Experiments
lore: Quartz's abilities of absorbing energy have been experimented on by various scientists throughout the years. Although it's potential is great, it becomes increasingly unstable when used.

steps.text: Enter the Llevigar Court building.
Walk up the stairs at [-2130, -4471] and turn right. Then walk up the stairway with the sign 'Courtrooms 1-3' and up the next stairway.
Enter the exploded house.
Cast a spell on the quartz orb to open the secret room.

name: Washed Away
lore: The chimes of Espren have long served as a symbol for the town, but what few now know is that they were once used as a secret way of communication between its residents. That was until 250 years ago, when it all was washed away…

steps.text: Near an Espren Citizen are four wind chimes with white particles glimmering from them. Interact with them from lowest to highest. A cutscene will play of the chimes ringing. A fox's face will appear on the wall as an underground room opens. "Tactical Demands" starts to play. The secret discovery is granted once the Player enters the hideout.

name: Watchmen
lore: From the watch towers set up across the province, scouts were able to spot an incoming horde from miles away, helping to prepare for countless battles.

steps.text: The first watchtower is at the eastern edge of Nivla Woods, before the bridge to Detlas Suburbs. Do the parkour inside to reach the top and hear its echo.
The second tower is in the centre of the woods, just south of the main road.
The third tower is in a small clearing in the north-western corner of the woods.
The fourth and smallest tower is just off the Emerald Trail, west of the woods, among other ruins. The towers can be visited in any order; the discovery comes with the last echo.

name: Water of the Past
lore: The proud farmers surrounding Ragni were often left to fend for themselves. They have proven to be resourceful and hardened. They created their own infrastructure, but when they were totally abandoned by the army, there was nothing but slaughter.

steps.text: Go to the ruins on the West side of Mt. Wynn.
To the east of the main entrance of the ruins is a Repair Kit. Collect it for the step after the next.
Under a part of the aqueduct are some Rubble mobs. Kill an entity to gather it for the next step.
Head up to the first hole that you must patch by right-clicking with the Repair Kit and the Rubble in your inventory.
Follow the water movement along until it reaches the next hole, punch the leaves away. Text will show up saying "Seems like some mechanism was activated..."
Follow the water again and wait for the water-powered cogs to spin. The door, that had an emerald block in it before, should open to the south-east of them.

name: Ways of the Wicked
lore: Kander may appear to be nothing but a dying forest filled with superstitious inhabitants, but something far more sinister has lurked beneath its repulsive veil.

steps.text: Interact with the telescope: you spot something glimmering in a tree trunk.
Collect the Golden Jewel
Interact with the bird carcass with the Golden Jewel in your inventory to collect the Blood-Infused Jewel
Interact with the wall with the Blood-Infused Jewel in your inventory

name: Wolf Temple
lore: This monument was build in memory of Bob, who supposedly fell to wild wolves here. Those who knew him have their doubts, however, and the origins of the mysterious temples and tombs are unknow.

steps.text: Climb the mountain starting at 281, 94, -804 and follow the particle trail.
Follow the blood trail and right or left click the animal corpse to get four Tasty Bone.
Enter the temple and feed the wolves in order from highest to lowest.
The door will be open

name: Wrecking Ball
lore: When the Creden Tibus discovered the Emperor's sceptre in an ancient, hidden temple, they decided to hide it closer to home. After many generations, they grew paranoid, and moved it once more.

steps.text: Go to the crashed Mesa Elevator located in the Mesa and obtain the Dangling Elevator Rope by killing the mob named "Dangling Rope" located at the top of the rock pile.
Go to the heavy boulder located north of the crashed elevator and right click the boulder with the Dangling Elevator Rope.
Turn left and follow the path up to the hole that the wrecking ball opened.

name: Wynn Plains Monument
requires: All other Wynn Plains Secret Discoveries found.
lore: This ancient monument only opens to those it deems worthy. Inside is contained secrets of the Wynn Plains that few eyes have ever seen.

steps.text: The entrance to the Ultimate Discovery is initially guarded by a mysterious ghostly soldier only known as ???. After all of the secrets have been discovered, the mysterious ghost will open the door. Inside are several Phantom Soldiers and some parkour to the top. Once reaching the top of the monument, an orb will prompt the discovery to start.
